project_name: CodexPlusBar App Icon From User-Edited Master SVG, 2026-08-17 13:57 WIB

palette_roles.purpose: Stable pale warm full-bleed field from the edited master SVG
Dark ends of the Codex gradient, cursor, and menu slots
Salmon center of the Codex mark gradient
Large subtle Codex tile that separates through Icon Composer material

design.app_purpose: Help people choose and manage the right Codex or Claude account from the macOS menu bar.
design.metaphor: A cursor choosing a Codex terminal badge from a menu bar.
design.primary_silhouette: One large dark-to-salmon Codex mark with a terminal prompt cutout.
design.supporting_idea: Three top menu slots and one large cursor show menu-bar selection.

optical_occupancy.notes: Measured from the corrected full-bleed 1024 px source composite. The 100% width comes from the user's deliberate left and right menu-slot bleed; the central Codex recognizer stays well inside the mask. The Apple grid, 64 px preview, neighboring-app scale, and compiled 256/128/16 px results all passed.

background_strategy.reason: Default keeps the user's pale warm field. Icon Composer remaps the same source geometry for Dark, Clear, and Tinted system appearances. One full-canvas opaque SVG removes the source's unintended 20 px transparent strip while preserving every foreground transform.

geometry_contract.occlusion_rule: Background, pale Codex tile, gradient Codex mark, cursor, then menu slots from back to front. The right slot intentionally covers the cursor where they overlap.
geometry_contract.notes: Flat stacked geometry from the edited SVG. No source-drawn extrusion. Cursor and menu slots are split because they overlap and need independent material edges.

design.notes: The edited master is the design authority. Foreground colors, shapes, transforms, and painting order are preserved. Only the background translation is corrected so the final platform mask never exposes a clear strip.

groups.name: 01_background
groups.purpose: Exact stable pale warm background field
groups.notes: Effects off; this is the only opaque source matte.

groups.name: 02_codex-tile
groups.notes: Individual mode; specular, blur, and translucency off at group level; neutral shadow. The tile layer keeps its own restrained effects on.

groups.name: 03_codex-logo
groups.purpose: Gradient Codex mark and overlapping cursor
groups.notes: Individual mode; group effects stay quiet. The mark and cursor are separate layers and both keep layer effects off so their source boundaries remain exact.

groups.name: 04_menu-slots
groups.notes: Individual mode with quiet group settings. The slot layer keeps restrained effects on and remains above the cursor where they overlap.

layers.name: 01_background
layers.notes: Corrects the edited master's 20 px transparent strip without moving its foreground artwork.

layers.name: 02_codex-tile
layers.purpose: Large pale tile behind the Codex mark.
layers.notes: The fill matches the background, so Icon Composer material supplies its subtle boundary.

layers.name: 03_codex-mark
layers.purpose: Large dark-to-salmon Codex mark with terminal glyph cutouts.
layers.notes: Deliberate SVG gradient #543A48 through #E67E80 to #543A48. Use the normal source audit, not strict-flat.

layers.name: 04_cursor
layers.purpose: Large dark cursor with a pale separation edge.
layers.notes: Preserves the edited master path, fill, transform, and 20.4 px stroke.

layers.name: 05_menu-slots
layers.purpose: Three front-most menu slots with deliberate canvas-edge bleed.
layers.material_unit: three disjoint slots with one shared material behavior
layers.notes: Separated from the cursor so the overlapping right slot and cursor keep independent material edges.

default.notes: The exported Default icon preserves the edited pale, plum, and salmon design and stays readable from 1024 through 16 px.

dark.notes: Icon Composer's blue Dark adaptation keeps the same Codex mark, cursor, terminal glyph, menu slots, and z order.

clear_light.notes: The Clear Light export keeps every recognizer in a coherent light monochrome rendering.

clear_dark.notes: The Clear Dark export keeps every recognizer in a stronger dark monochrome rendering.

tinted_light.notes: The Tinted Light export keeps the same silhouette and hierarchy in the system violet tint.

tinted_dark.notes: The darkest system tint is intentionally low contrast, but the Codex cloud, terminal cutouts, cursor, and menu slots remain visible at 64 px.

source_audit.notes: Normal audit: 5 SVG, 0 PNG, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Strict-flat is intentionally not used because the edited Codex mark contains a deliberate SVG gradient.

flat_preview_64.notes: The Codex mark, terminal cutouts, cursor, and menu slots remain readable at 1024, 256, 128, and 64 px in review/source-refresh-20260817-1401.

optical_scale.notes: Source bounds are [0,107,1024,853], or 100% × 72.8516%. The full width is intentional menu-slot bleed. The Apple grid and compiled 256, 128, and 16 px icons show balanced scale without mask crowding.

geometry_integrity.notes: Five truthful stacked material layers preserve the edited SVG painting order. There is no extrusion, detached geometry, or unsafe merged overlap.

material_edge_integrity.notes: Default was checked near -48°, +89°, and -170° light angles. The tile and menu-slot effects stay restrained; source-defined mark and cursor boundaries remain crisp.

transform_audit.notes: All five imported full-canvas layers were verified at x 0 pt, y 0 pt, scale 100%, with no rotation before save. The reopened official file still reports 5 layers in 4 groups.

background_appearance.notes: Default uses one opaque full-bleed #EFEBD4 layer and preserves the user's foreground +20 px transform. Dark, Clear, and Tinted are deliberate Icon Composer system adaptations of the same geometry.

rendered_matrix.notes: Default, Dark, and Mono were inspected at 1024, 128, and 64 px, on solid and built-in image backgrounds, with the grid both on and off and with three light angles. All six flattened appearances were inspected at 1024 and 64 px.

color_audit.notes: Source-token audit: #543A48 on #EFEBD4 passes at 8.432648:1 and delta L* 65.064489; #E5DFC5 on #543A48 passes at 7.560076:1 and delta L* 60.947381. The deliberate salmon gradient midpoint #E67E80 on #EFEBD4 is 2.284948:1 and delta L* 28.045708; it is supporting dynamic color, not the only recognizer, and needs rendered small-size review.

export_decode.notes: verify_icon_exports.py decoded every exported PNG and found all required macOS appearances and sizes.

reopen_check.notes: Resources/AppIcon.icon was saved, closed, and reopened from its absolute path. It retained 5 layers in 4 groups, macOS Only on, watchOS off, sRGB treatment, appearances, and transforms.

simulator_or_device.notes: The strict Debug macOS build succeeded. actool compiled Resources/AppIcon.icon as AppIcon; the built bundle contains AppIcon.icns and Assets.car, and the compiled 256, 128, and 16 px icons were visually checked.

qa.dynamic_color_notes: Default must preserve the user's edited colors. Dark, Clear, Tinted, and Mono may remap color, but must keep the same Codex mark, terminal glyph, cursor, menu slots, and z order.

essential_symbol_pairs.notes: Dark Codex edges, cursor, and menu slots against the stable field.

deliverables.notes: Resources/AppIcon.icon is the canonical macOS-only Icon Composer document. The older production icon is preserved in work/checkpoint-before-user-svg-refresh-20260817-1401. The strict Debug build consumed the canonical file successfully.
